- Vendor risk sheet completed; there are a couple of minor clarifications in section 4 (data processing subprocessors) that Marissa may want to confirm.

Thanks for the ping, Ben. Lena — I reviewed the COI and the vendor questionnaire. A few notes: 

1) COI: Certificate is valid but does not include Additional Insured. For our standard onboarding we request one of the following:
   - a) COI naming Redwood Inference as Certificate Holder with an Additional Insured endorsement attached (preferred), or
   - b) COI plus a signed endorsement PDF that adds Additional Insured status for General Liability.

2) Limits: The COI shows GL $1M each occurrence / $2M aggregate which is acceptable. Professional Liability (E&O) is not listed — can you confirm if you have $1M E&O? If yes, please provide either the policy page or an updated COI that lists it.

3) Vendor risk form: Section 4 — please clarify which subprocessors you use for telemetry and metrics; a short list (vendor + region) is sufficient.

If those items can be supplied, procurement can finalize the PO. Laura — once SkyBridge provides the AI/metrics subprocessor list and confirmation of E&O, you should be able to issue PO-78654.

Lena — happy to accept the COI and endorsement as separate PDFs or an updated single certificate. If it's easier, DocuSign link for a quick endorsement also works.

--
Marissa Cole
Sr. Risk Analyst | Redwood Inference
